context.label: Fulfillment
context.description: Choose a line to reserve stock, or a reservation to ship.

presentation.description: Reservation-scoped availability for this item and location. Missing or unavailable data is not zero stock.

actions.label: Reserve stock
actions.description: On hand stays unchanged; available stock decreases.

actions.label: Ship reserved stock
actions.description: On hand and reserved stock decrease by the shipped quantity.

actions.label: Release remainder
actions.description: On hand stays unchanged; the remaining reservation becomes available.

actions.label: Open packing
actions.description: Open the complete committed shipment document.

documentEditor.saveDescription: Save commits the header and each line in sequence. Drafts do not change stock. Release is a separate action.

create.label: New customer
create.explanation: Creates the customer now as its own record. Saving or discarding this order does not undo it.

create.label: New product
create.explanation: Creates the product now as its own record. Saving or discarding this order does not undo it.

context.label: Receiving
context.description: Choose an order line to receive it. Actual cost is entered explicitly; draft editing and Release remain separate.

actions.label: Receive with actual cost
actions.description: Post received quantity using the actual received cost and currency you enter.

actions.label: Receive with cost explicitly absent
actions.description: Post received quantity with actual cost explicitly recorded as absent. Order price is not received cost.

actions.label: Open receipt
actions.description: Open the connected receipt and its existing amendment/correction workflow.
